test_title: PYST 14: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 9 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underline segment in the given sentence.

A dishonest employee __plays fast__ with his boss.
solution:
The correct answer is** "plays fast and loose"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Let's see the correct substitution:

__
 
• A dishonest employee** plays fast and loose** with his boss.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's see how the sentence formed:

 
• **Plays fast and loose - **behave irresponsibly or immorally.
 
• Here this sentence means that if the employee is dishonest or mean he/she will behave rude and irresponsible with his boss
